# Written by Drove on every Codex worker launch in this run (DROVE-34). Edits here, Codex's included, are overwritten.

command = "node"
args = ["/opt/drove/src/cli.ts", "mcp"]
env_vars = ["DROVE_HOME", "DROVE_RUN", "DROVE_ROLE", "DROVE_SEAT", "DROVE_TOKEN"]
default_tools_approval_mode = "approve"

[mcp_servers.docs]
command = "npx"
args = [
  "docs-mcp",
]

[mcp_servers.docs.env]
